The '''Coruscant Security Droid Blaster''' was a type of [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] issued to [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] who were assigned to the [[Coruscant Underworld Police]].
